title.en: Flow rate through a narrowing conduit

summary: Compare cross-sectional average speeds while a fixed volume flow passes through different pipe areas.
objective: Build a cutaway nozzle with adjustable radii and linked cross-section disks showing A*v=Q.
intent_signals: Build a cutaway nozzle with adjustable radii and linked cross-section disks showing A*v=Q.
Compare cross-sectional average speeds while a fixed volume flow passes through different pipe areas.
example_prompts: Build a cutaway nozzle with adjustable radii and linked cross-section disks showing A*v=Q.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of equation of continuity with equal-volume packets.
negative_signals: No pressure-drop, viscosity, pump, compressibility or free-jet model.
not_for: No pressure-drop, viscosity, pump, compressibility or free-jet model.

entities.name: Conduit shell
entities.guidance: Create a smooth axisymmetric wall with two straight measurement sections and a short taper; a cutaway exposes the bore, not a second tube.

entities.name: Section disks
entities.guidance: Place translucent disks normal to the axis at two locations, labeling radius, area and mean speed in SI units.

entities.name: Equal-volume packets
entities.guidance: Compare equal-volume packets wholly inside the two straight constant-area measurement sections, with length V/A and V small enough to fit. In a taper, a finite packet would require integrating A(x) over its length; do not extend the local shortcut there.

state_contract.model: Steady incompressible flow with fixed Q>=0 and positive radius r(x); cross-sectional mean speed vbar(x)=Q/(pi*r(x)^2). This is a one-dimensional continuity model, not a solved velocity profile.
state_contract.authority: Conduit area and declared Q own average-speed values; tracer motion is a schematic encoding and does not establish local Navier-Stokes dynamics.
actions: Change inlet or outlet radius above a declared positive minimum.
Pause packets and inspect both cross-sections.

invariants: Halving radius at fixed Q multiplies mean speed by four.
Zero flow gives zero mean speed and stationary packet indicators.
motion_guidance: Keep the finite packet comparison at the straight stations. Optional point tracers on the axis may advance using vbar(x) with bounded steps, explicitly labeled schematic rather than finite material packets.
Do not show turbulence, vortices or a viscous velocity profile unless a separate model supplies them.
known_limits: No pressure-drop, viscosity, pump, compressibility or free-jet model.
A single mean speed does not describe local velocity across the bore or wall boundary layers.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: For steady incompressible flow without sources or sinks, cross-sectional area times average speed is the same volume flow rate at each section.
claims.scope: Cross-sectional average values in the declared steady conduit, not arbitrary unsteady flow.

source_refs.locator: 14.5, Flow Rate and its Relation to Velocity, equation 14.14

object_craft.structure: Create a smooth axisymmetric wall with two straight measurement sections and a short taper; a cutaway exposes the bore, not a second tube.
object_craft.material: Opaque outer shell with removable quadrant, pale fluid interior and thin high-contrast section rings; optical liquid appearance is illustrative.

physical_contract.scope: Prescribed cross-sectional mean flow from continuity, not a fluid solver.
colliders: No rigid-body colliders; any boundary is part of the declared mathematical model.
driving: Q and area determine mean speed.
contact: No collision or impact response is supplied by this field model.
physical_contract.timestep: Evaluate the declared analytic state at paused or running model time; rendering never advances a second model.
checks: Compare products A*v at both stations.
